name: potrace
use: monochrome bitmap to vector tracing (scans and doodles to vector parts, WP-18)
build: touch -d '2000-01-01' configure.ac Makefile.am */Makefile.am m4/*.m4 && touch aclocal.m4 && touch configure config.h.in Makefile.in */Makefile.in
build_note: the first step orders the timestamps (sources old, then aclocal.m4, then configure and the Makefile.in files), so make uses the released autotools output instead of regenerating it with automake: a copy or checkout gives every file a new, arbitrary mtime
